summary: Added non-negotiable 8 to /vessel-ai: in a Time game mode an AI puts speed before breaking (breaks only what it cannot pass, passes as soon as it can, takes a pickup on its way). Added two traps the Switchback work hit (a pass point sized from the door's eye instead of the ring's mouth; 'on the way' judged by distance instead of time).
why: Yash, 2026-11-17, after watching a Switchback AI leave a ring it could fly for another crystal: 'we should always prioritize speed over breaking as it is time game. This is the general rule for AI training in Time Game Modes.'
